name: Evan's Remains
source:
Travel to an uninhabited island in the middle of the pacific ocean to find a missing boy.

Years after a boy genius named Evan disappears, a bizarre letter arrives. Evan wants a girl named Dysis to come find him. As Dysis, you’ll need to solve an intricate series of puzzles to unravel the entire mystery—and bring Evan home.

Steeped in inspiration from Japanese graphic adventures, Evan’s Remains is a mystery-thriller puzzler that’s part graphic novel and part puzzle platformer. Navigate your way through the strange island to complete the puzzles, find Evan, and uncover the truth about his disappearance.

[From [url=https://whitethorngames.com/evans-remains]the official website[/url]]
translation:
前往太平洋中部的一个无人居住的岛屿寻找失踪的男孩。

一位名叫埃文的天才男孩失踪多年后，一封奇怪的信收到了。埃文希望一个名叫戴西斯的女孩来找他。作为戴西斯，你需要解决一系列错综复杂的谜题来解开整个谜团，并将埃文带回家。

《埃文的遗迹》深受日本图画冒险的启发，是一款半图画小说、半解谜平台游戏的悬疑惊悚解谜游戏。穿过陌生的岛屿，完成谜题，找到埃文，并揭开他失踪的真相。

[来自[url=https://whitethorngames.com/evans-remains]官方网站[/url]]
